_purpose: WireWise layout defaults for values the rule profile does not define. Kept separate so rule-profile.json can be replaced without losing them. Every block has a _source; the app shows its trust tag.

room_type_to_profile._source: design choice — maps WireWise room types to rule-profile lighting_design.target_lux keys. utility and other have no key, so they get a 'not in rule profile' warning.

sockets_per_room._source: unverified — WireWise design default (typical UK new-build practice), not from BS 7671 or the rule profile. Replace with your own values. Bathroom/WC are 0 because of the Section 701 socket distance rule.

placement_cm._source: design choice — plan positions only; mounting heights come from rule-profile sockets
